topline.text: Sheffield City Council's finance and performance policy committee approved funding yesterday to expand three secondary schools - Hinde House, Forge Valley and Yewlands - as officers warn the city faces a shortage of Year 7 places through 2029.
topline.action: Worth knowing whether any MAPs partner schools sit in these expansion catchments as places tighten.

topline.text: Reminder: DfE's call for evidence on exclusion reform (internal suspension, reintegration partnerships, schoolwork during suspension) closes in 2 days, on Thursday 19 November.
Anti-Bullying Week 2026 continues under the 'Break the Silence' theme - today is day two of five.
Otherwise a quiet 24-48 hours nationally - no new DfE, Ofsted, safeguarding or funding announcement cleared the corroboration bar today.

diary.text: Anti-Bullying Week 2026 continues - 'Break the Silence' theme; day two of five today.
DfE's call for evidence on school exclusion reform (internal suspension, reintegration partnerships, managed moves) closes - 2 days away.
DfE due to publish autumn 2025/26 suspensions and permanent exclusions statistics for England.

items.lede: Three Sheffield secondary schools approved for expansion as council plans for a place shortage.
items.body: Sheffield City Council's finance and performance policy committee has approved a package of works: a £1.1m temporary expansion adding 90 places at Hinde House in Shiregreen, a £4.5m three-storey extension at Forge Valley School in Stannington, and £200,000 to explore options at Yewlands Academy. Officers say Year 7 demand will keep rising across the city to 2029 and the council risks breaching its statutory duty to provide enough places if it doesn't act now.
items.action: Worth checking whether any MAPs partner schools sit in these catchments - rising Year 7 numbers can squeeze SEND and inclusion provision fastest.

items.lede: Exclusion reform call for evidence enters its final 48 hours.
items.body: The DfE's call for evidence on internal suspension, reintegration support partnerships and schoolwork provision during the first days of a suspension or permanent exclusion closes Thursday 19 November. It feeds the 'Every Child Achieving and Thriving' white paper's proposed time-limited internal suspension framework.
items.action: Last chance for any Sheffield-side input before Thursday's deadline.

box.text: additional Year 7 places Sheffield City Council plans to add at Hinde House alone, part of a wider package addressing forecast secondary place shortages to 2029.
